title: drosera monantha
intro: Drosera monantha, commonly known as the solitary sundew, is a species of carnivorous plant belonging to the Droseraceae family. It is known for its unique ability to capture and digest insects for nutrients, making it an essential part of its survival in nutrient-poor environments. The health benefits of Drosera monantha include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Drosera monantha include iridoid glycosides, such as droserone and rotundine, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including bronchodilation and anti-inflammatory effects.
